1. How to activate the world change
A new steamship links Kazordoon to Thais, but the way is flooded in the {wiki:Sunken Mines}. The water pumps brought in to drain the area need coal to work.
Gather {item:Coal}. **202** pieces need to be delivered in total (several players can contribute). {creature:Carrion Worm|Carrion Worms} swallow coal and Cyclopes usually carry it.

Go to the {wiki:Sunken Mines}, near **Kazordoon**, and go down to {npc:Dronk}, who watches over the water pumps. You can say {key:hi} and {key:help} for him to explain the problem (pumps, {key:pool}, {key:Groam}, {key:voices}). The mines are **west** of Kazordoon, outside the mountain. To get to Kazordoon use the {wiki:Steamship} from {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Gurbasch}) or from Farmine ({npc:Thorgrin}) with {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}, or go on foot through the mountain entrance; then leave the mountain and walk west to the entrance. Dronk is **two floors below** the entrance.
Use the coal on the pumps
Use the {item:Coal} on any of the **three Water Pumps** in the mine. When enough coal has been used, the pumps start working on their own and the mines open at the **next server save**.
Go back the same way: climb the two floors to the entrance and return to Kazordoon to the **east**. With the mines open, you can also leave via {npc:Junkar}'s steamship (see section 2).

The next day the entrance becomes visible and you can enter a dungeon full of {creature:Deepling Scout|Deepling Scouts}. In the mines you can also find {creature:Groam}, Dronk's missing friend; killing him gives the achievement **Eye of the Deep**.

Every day a certain number of Deepling Scouts has to be killed. If not, they flood the dungeon again and everything has to be drained again (with more coal) to regain access to the hunting ground and the steamship.
Eye of the Deep achievement (when killing Groam)

This steamship is different from the one inside Kazordoon: it takes you to **Thais**, **Kazordoon** (the traditional steamship) or {wiki:Robson's Isle}. The captain is {npc:Junkar}: say {key:hi} and {key:passage}. When the mines are flooded, the {key:mines} option does not work.
Say {key:awash} to any Guide NPC. The reply tells you what stage your server is at:
Coal still needs to be delivered.
There is already enough coal: the mines open at the next server save.
Mines open and enough deeplings have already been killed today.
Mines open, but more deeplings need to be killed today, otherwise they flood again at server save.
After 5 days without enough deeplings killed, the mines flood again.
